summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built Python software for laboratory data acquisition and for a Linux-based Jetson controller driving hardware over UART and I2C. Developed embedded C/C++ firmware on STM32 and Arduino, with Git and GitLab version control.

Linux & Tools: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used Git on GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning PCB fabrication, sensor communication and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled pick-and-place system in Python and C++: Flask-SocketIO edge server plus Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket; 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials), ~11.5s end-to-end.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge on Linux as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file config) with static IP networking.
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via a TCA9548A I2C mux; resolved 11 integration failures (servo brown-out, stale frames, false positives).

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 firmware in embedded C with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed GPIO, TIM2, ADC1 and I2C1 directly; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Sent YOLOv8 detections from a Jetson to an STM32 over UART; implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance display.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
